title: Brethren We Have Met to Worship
lyrics_original: Brethren we have met to worship,
And adore the Lord our God;
Will you pray with all your power,
While we try to preach the Word?
All is vain unless the Spirit
Of the Holy One comes down
Brethren, pray, & holy manna
Will be showered all around.
[Sisters]
Brethren see poor sinners round you
Slumbering on the brink of woe;
Death is coming, hell is moving,
Can you bear to let them go?
See our fathers and our mothers
And our children sinking down!
Brethren, pray and holy manna
will be showered all around.
[Brothers]
Sisters, will you join and help us?
Moses' sister aided him;
Will you help the trembling mourners
Who are struggling hard with sin?
Tell them all about the Savior
Tell them that He will be found!
Sisters, pray, and holy manna
Will be showered all around.
Let us love our God supremely,
Let us love each other, too;
Let us love and pray for sinners,
'Till our God makes all things new.
Then He'll call us home to Heaven
At His table we'll sit down.
Christ will gird Himself and serve us
With sweet manna all around.

bible_verses.english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the midst of them.”
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.”

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the privilege of gathering with fellow believers in Your presence. Send Your Holy Spirit down among us today, for we know that all our efforts are in vain without Your power. Feed our hungry souls with Christ, the true Bread of Life, and soften our hearts to pray earnestly for others. Fill our worship with Your living grace and joy. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we gather for worship, our heart's deepest need is not eloquent words or perfect music, but the living presence of the Holy Spirit. This classic hymn reminds us that true spiritual revival happens when believers unite in earnest prayer, asking God to move among them. As we seek Him together, Christ faithfully meets us and pours out His "holy manna"—the abundant, soul-satisfying grace of His presence. May our worship today be humbled by prayer and filled with quiet expectation.
